title: ORE Debt Module
description: Optional simple loan terms for levered returns. ORE v0.1 supports a single fixed-rate loan sized by amount or LTV; waterfalls and floating rates are out of scope.

loanAmount.description: Loan amount in USD. Provide this or ltvPercent, not both.

ltvPercent.description: Loan-to-value in percent, applied to valuation.purchasePrice (which must be present when sizing by LTV).

interestRatePercent.description: Fixed annual interest rate in percent. v0.1 supports fixed rates only.

rateType.description: v0.1 supports fixed-rate debt only; future versions will widen this enum.

termMonths.description: Loan term in months from fundingDate. If the term ends before the hold period, engines assume payoff of the outstanding balance at term end refinanced on identical terms; state deviations in notes.

amortizationMonths.description: Amortization schedule in months (e.g. 360 for 30-year). Omit for interest-only through the full term.

interestOnlyMonths.description: Interest-only period in months at the start of the loan, before amortization begins.

originationFeePercent.description: Origination fee as a percent of loan amount, deducted from proceeds at funding.

fundingDate.description: Loan funding date. Defaults to valuation.analysisStartDate.
